editorialSummary.heading: Early release times, school breaks and hurricane make-up days
highlights: Ten early-release dates, including four professional-development days and six semester-end days
No student classes January 4 or March 22; scheduled returns January 5 and March 23
November 23-24 and March 15-16 are reserved for possible hurricane make-up
paragraphs: Hernando County has ten early-release dates in the 2026-27 school year. August 28, September 25, January 29 and February 26 are for professional development. December 16-18 and May 26-28 are the three shortened days at the end of each semester. Students attend school on all ten dates, but they leave earlier than usual.

Early dismissal times vary by school. D.S. Parrott Middle School dismisses at 11:00 a.m., Hernando High at 11:20 a.m., and several elementary schools at 1:10 p.m. Families should check their school's listed early-release time before arranging pickup, especially if their child attends a separate program.

Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026, and spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Four of those dates - November 23-24 and March 15-16 - are reserved for possible hurricane make-up. They are scheduled without student classes under the published calendar, but the district may use them as school days if needed. Families should check for updates before making travel arrangements.

Winter break runs from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional day with no student classes, so students are scheduled to return January 5. Spring break is followed by another professional day on March 22, with students scheduled back March 23. There is also no school on Friday, March 26, which the district labels Long weekend. The last day of school is May 28, with early release.

about.dataSource: The currently linked 2026-2027 Student Calendar and separate 2026-2027 Approved Bell Times. The student PDF matches the supplied local file by SHA-256. Both documents were reviewed visually alongside their text. The current Teacher Calendar was used only to corroborate student-free professional days and shortened dates.
about.processing: The green student grid marks attendance; unshaded March 22 is a teacher professional day, not a student class date. PreSchool August 4-7 and 10 is staff preparation, not a preschool student session. Exclude staff first day, pre/post-school preparation, employee payroll holidays and Memorial Day after the student year. Keep full student-free professional days October 12, October 30, January 4 and March 22. The four PD early-release dates are attendance dates, not full staff-only days. Expand the two explicit semester-end early-release ranges into daily canonical occurrences; partition dates are derived, while published quarter/last-day endpoints remain official. December 18 combines early release, grading and semester end. May 28 combines last day, early release, grading and semester end. October 9 and March 12 are regular-length grading ends. Do not add exam classifications without a published exam schedule. Keep the exact named break ranges November 23-27, December 21-January 1 and March 15-19. Partition Thanksgiving into individual November 23/24 conditional reserve occurrences and the derived fixed November 25-27 segment; partition spring identically into March 15/16 reserves and March 17-19 fixed segment. Each date is stored once. Retain the complete named range in breaks/keyDates with reserve caveats; do not mark all five days conditional or treat two reserve dates as guaranteed closures. Conditional dates use the published no-class baseline, mayBecomeAttendanceDay and no absolute attendance flag. January 5 and March 23 returns are derived; the PDF does not explicitly state them as return entries. March 23-25 remain scheduled attendance days before the separately named Long weekend on March 26. The four printed quarter figures total 180 (43+42+47+48), a derived annual sum matching 209 weekdays minus 25 fixed closures and 4 conditional no-class reserve weekdays. The fixed no-school statistic excludes reserves; it is not the full planned 29-day exclusion. The 23 school bell rows come from the separate Board-approved March 24, 2026 table. Interpret the start column as morning instruction, ordinary end as afternoon dismissal, and early-release times before noon as a.m./later times as p.m.; keep drop-off separate in row notes. Do not apply the bell-table approval date to the annual calendar. Eastside is labeled ES in that table; its own page describes an elementary 9 a.m.-3:40 p.m. day and includes arrival at 8:40 a.m. in its broader hours block. Retain its row scope without extending an elementary timetable to an unverified grade program. School Board records confirm that Calendar A was adopted on February 10, 2026, under item 26-3513. The Calendar page's March 10 document label does not establish a later revision, and the March 24 approval applies to the separate bell-times schedule.
about.updates: Verified October 19, 2026 against the current Calendar and District Bell Schedule pages and linked PDFs. District homepage news and Nature Coast school announcements were reviewed for operating changes. No confirmed activation of the four hurricane reserves or a later districtwide schedule revision was verified. Some newer Nature Coast weekly-news entries appeared in search results but their linked full notices were not consistently retrievable; no additional shortened date was inferred from a flyer headline. Direct HTML fetches sometimes failed, while the official PDF downloads and web reader remained accessible. Board adoption was checked October 23, 2026 against item 26-3513 and the final February 10 meeting minutes, which record adoption of Calendar A for 2026-2027. The Calendar A attachment could not be downloaded during this update, so exact document-level agreement with the currently published Student Calendar is not independently verified. This approval check does not establish a later operational revision or activation of hurricane reserves.
about.disclaimer: Check district and school announcements before relying on hurricane reserve dates for travel. School-specific exam, program, transportation and later schedule notices may require different arrangements.

faqs.question: When does the 2026-27 school year start in Hernando County?
faqs.answer: The first day of school for students is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. The earlier August dates listed for staff preparation are not student attendance days.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hernando County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last scheduled day for students. It is also an early-release day and the end of the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: Does Hernando County have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026-27 Student Calendar does not list a separate October fall break. Students have no classes on October 12 for a professional day or October 30 for district in-service. Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, with November 23-24 reserved for possible hurricane make-up.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Hernando County schools?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27, 2026. November 23 and 24 are possible hurricane make-up days, so students may need to attend school on those dates if the district activates them. Under the published schedule, regular classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Hernando County winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a professional day without student classes, so students are scheduled to return Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends, the planned time off is December 19 through January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Hernando County schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. March 15 and 16 are reserved for possible hurricane make-up. Monday, March 22 is a separate professional day with no student classes, making Tuesday, March 23 the scheduled return under the published calendar.

faqs.question: Do students have school on Monday, March 22, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. March 22 is a teacher professional day, not a regular student attendance day. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, March 23, after spring break, unless the district announces a schedule change.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday, March 26, 2027, a school day?
faqs.answer: No student classes are scheduled for Friday, March 26. The district calendar labels this date Long weekend rather than Good Friday. Students are scheduled to attend March 23-25 and return Monday, March 29 after the long weekend.

faqs.question: What are the early-release days for the 2026-27 school year?
faqs.answer: Hernando County lists ten early-release dates: August 28, September 25 and December 16-18, 2026; January 29, February 26 and May 26-28, 2027. The August, September, January and February dates are for professional development. The December and May dates are semester-end early releases.

faqs.question: What time do Hernando County high schools dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Hernando High School dismisses at 11:20 a.m. Central, Nature Coast Technical, F.W. Springstead and Weeki Wachee high schools dismiss at 11:10 a.m. These times come from the district's approved 2026-27 bell schedule.

faqs.question: What time does Endeavor dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Endeavor is listed with an 11:05 a.m. early dismissal. Its regular school hours are 7:25 a.m. to 2:05 p.m., with drop-off listed at 7:05 a.m. Check directly with the school for any program-specific arrangements.

faqs.question: What time do Hernando County middle and K-8 schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: D.S. Parrott Middle School dismisses at 11:00 a.m. Fox Chapel, Powell and West Hernando middle schools, along with Explorer K-8 and Winding Waters K-8, dismiss at 12:10 p.m. Challenger K-8 dismisses at 12:55 p.m. These are the times listed in the district's 2026-27 bell schedule.

faqs.question: What time do Hernando County elementary schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: Brooksville Elementary and Moton Elementary dismiss at 12:40 p.m. The Eastside ES row also lists 12:40 p.m.; confirm arrangements for other grades or programs directly with Eastside. Chocachatti, Deltona, J.D. Floyd, Pine Grove, Spring Hill, Suncoast and Westside elementary schools dismiss at 1:10 p.m.

faqs.question: What time do Hernando County schools start?
faqs.answer: Start times vary by campus. Hernando High, Central High, Nature Coast, Springstead and Weeki Wachee start at 7:20 a.m. D.S. Parrott starts at 7:30 a.m., Brooksville Elementary at 9:00 a.m., and Chocachatti Elementary at 9:30 a.m. Check the district bell schedule for the start time at your school.

faqs.question: What time do Hernando County schools dismiss on regular school days?
faqs.answer: Regular dismissal depends on the school. Hernando High ends at 2:20 p.m., D.S. Parrott Middle School at 2:00 p.m., Explorer K-8 at 3:10 p.m., Brooksville Elementary at 3:40 p.m., and Chocachatti Elementary at 4:10 p.m. Check the school-specific bell schedule for other campuses.

faqs.question: Is student drop-off time the same as the school start time?
faqs.answer: No. The district bell schedule lists drop-off and school start times separately. For example, Hernando High lists 7:00 a.m. drop-off and a 7:20 a.m. start. D.S. Parrott lists 7:10 a.m. drop-off and a 7:30 a.m. start. Use your school's listed drop-off time rather than assuming it begins when classes start.

faqs.question: Which dates could become hurricane make-up school days?
faqs.answer: The four listed hurricane make-up dates are November 23-24, 2026, and March 15-16, 2027. All four fall within the district's published Thanksgiving or spring breaks. They are scheduled without student classes unless the district uses them for make-up instruction. Families should watch for district announcements before treating these dates as guaranteed days off.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and in-service days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on October 12 and October 30, 2026, or January 4 and March 22, 2027. October 30 is a district in-service day. The four professional-development early-release dates are different: students still attend school, but leave early.

faqs.question: Is there school on Friday, October 30, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. October 30 is a district in-service day, with students not in attendance. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 2, after the weekend.

faqs.question: Is there school on Election Day, November 3, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tuesday, November 3, 2026, is a scheduled student attendance day on the Hernando County school calendar. It is not listed as a districtwide school holiday. Check your school for any campus-specific announcements.

faqs.question: Do Hernando County students have school on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no classes on Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Are Hernando County schools closed on Veterans Day 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The district calendar labels the date Veterans Day Observed.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a no-school day for students in Hernando County.

faqs.question: Do Hernando County students have school on Presidents Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Students are off Monday, February 15, 2027, for Presidents Day.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, then March 12 and May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 are early-release days. October 9 and March 12 are scheduled as regular-length school days, not early-release dates.

faqs.question: Are October 9, 2026, and March 12, 2027, early-release days?
faqs.answer: No. October 9 and March 12 mark the ends of the first and third grading periods, but both are regular-length student days on the published calendar. The semester-end early-release dates are December 16-18 and May 26-28.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the 2026-27 Hernando County calendar?
faqs.answer: The four grading-period counts in the student calendar add up to 180 days: 43 + 42 + 47 + 48. This is a calculated total, not a separately printed annual figure. Weather closures or the use of make-up days could affect the operating schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official 2026-27 Hernando County school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Visit the Hernando County School District's School Calendars page and open the 2026-2027 Student Calendar. The teacher and employee calendars are separate documents. For campus start, drop-off and early dismissal times, use the district's separate District Bell Schedule.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to charter schools, Hernando eSchool and technical-college programs?
faqs.answer: This page follows the district's regular 2026-27 Student Calendar. It does not verify that every charter school, Hernando eSchool program or technical-college program follows exactly the same dates. Check the individual school or program calendar before relying on these dates.

faqs.question: Is the Hernando County school calendar available in Spanish or Haitian Creole?
faqs.answer: The district says its downloadable documents can be accessed in Spanish, Haitian Creole and other languages once opened. Use the language and accessibility options provided with the document on the official School Calendars page.

faqs.question: Does the 2026-27 student calendar include graduation ceremony dates?
faqs.answer: No. The district's 2026-27 Student Calendar does not list graduation ceremonies. Check your high school's announcements for confirmed dates and times. May 28 is the last scheduled student day, not a confirmed graduation date.

faqs.question: Does the district calendar list final exam dates?
faqs.answer: The district Student Calendar does not provide school-specific final exam schedules. December 16-18 and May 26-28 are listed as semester-end early-release dates, but that does not establish which days individual schools will hold exams. Check with your school for its exam schedule.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: The School Board adopted Calendar A for 2026-2027 on February 10, 2026, under item 26-3513. The agenda attachments identify the 2026-27 calendar, although one sentence in the executive summary inconsistently refers to 2025-2026. The Calendar A attachment has not been directly compared with the currently published Student Calendar PDF, so exact document-level agreement is not independently verified. The March 10 listing date is not the Board adoption date.
